command:
printf 'DEVICE_PERMISSIONS
'; ls -l /dev/ttyACM* /dev/video* /dev/media* /dev/nvhost* /dev/nvmap /tmp/argus_socket 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
USB_IDENTITIES
'; udevadm info --query=property --name=/dev/ttyACM0 | grep -E '^(ID_VENDOR_ID|ID_MODEL_ID|ID_MODEL=|ID_VENDOR=|ID_USB_INTERFACE_NUM|ID_PATH=|DEVNAME=|DEVLINKS=)'; udevadm info --attribute-walk --name=/dev/snd/controlC2 | head -n 100
printf '
AUDIO_FORMATS
'; cat /proc/asound/card2/stream0; amixer -c Device scontents
printf '
CAMERA_KERNEL_LOG
'; dmesg --color=never | grep -Ei 'imx|ov[0-9]|camera|camrtc|tegra.*vi|i2c.*(error|fail)' | tail -n 100
printf '
DEVICE_TREE_CAMERAS
'; find /proc/device-tree -iname '*imx*' -o -iname '*ov56*' -o -path '*/tegra-camera-platform/modules/*' | head -n 100
printf '
CAMERA_SYSFS
'; find /sys/bus/i2c/devices -maxdepth 2 -name name -exec sh -c 'printf "%s " "$1"; cat "$1"' _ {} \; | grep -Ei 'imx|ov|219|708|camera|tca|mux' || true
printf '
CAMERA_PORT_CONFIG
'; cat /boot/extlinux/extlinux.conf; ls -l /boot/*imx* /boot/*camera* 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
OPEN_DEVICES
'; fuser /dev/snd/* /dev/ttyACM0 /dev/video* 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
DEVICE_RULES
'; grep -R -nE 'nvhost|nvmap|video4linux|SUBSYSTEM=="sound"|c0de|0d8c' /etc/udev/rules.d /lib/udev/rules.d | head -n 60
